name: Race Pike
shortDescription: A long hunger in the mill-race that is not a student.
lookDescription: A long dark shape holds the mill-race and does not blink like a fish should.
examineDescription: The Race Pike is a fish that learned to keep a stone in the current. It is not a person. Solo work. Leave it if you only came for the osiers. Square up if it will not let the race run.
lockNarration: The race flattens, as if something wide had decided to stay.
victoryNarration: The Race Pike slips under ordinary water. A smooth stone knocks the piling.
